description: Stopping before a stage skips its conditional declarations, including conflicts with caller exclusion.

documents.p.md:
```jbogenbau
%stage first
%ambiguity-resolution greedy
%rule text A
%emits
%stage second
%features f
%conditions $.classes ∩ A ≠ ∅
%ambiguity-resolution greedy
%rule text f? A

```
